description: Runtime errors since the game started, explained: kind (your-code, debuff-usage, debuff-bug, outside), where (source file:line, source-mapped), a hint, the loop phase and tick, and a repeat count. A loop error stops the game; fix it, then game_pause false to resume. For debuff-bug, tell the human and share reportUrl rather than working around it. Type errors aren't runtime errors: use typecheck.
name: game_errors
title: Runtime errors
